about: The Overgrown Halls: plants, mossy rocks and roots from Stylized Nature to dress the Ruins (art brief region 1: moss, roots, overgrowth). The Ruins pieces themselves come from convert-ruins.sh.

kits.grid: Organic props, no grid; pivot at the base centre, y = 0 at the ground (roots and rocks dip a little below). The kit is about twice the Ruins' size: at 0.5 a fern is ~1.4 m wide, grass 0.3–0.9 m, a medium rock ~1.6 m, a dead tree ~5 m tall (the Ruins' own Tree_1 is 2.8 m).

pieces.Fern_1: ferns in corners and along wall bases
pieces.Plant_1: low leafy plant at wall bases and in cracks
pieces.Plant_7: flat ground leaves in floor gaps
pieces.Grass_Wispy_Tall: wispy tall grass under cracks in the wall
pieces.Bush_Common: bush grown through a broken wall
pieces.Mushroom_Laetiporus: bracket fungus on roots or wall bases (heavy: one per room)
pieces.DeadTree_1: dead tree sunk into the floor so only roots and stump show (root tunnels)
pieces.DeadTree_3: dead tree, the sealed rooms' root wall (sink deep; heavy)
